implement_Service_subclass: implement a custom RPC service subclass that overrides CallMethod and GetDescriptor
implement_RpcController_subclass: implement a custom RpcController subclass that overrides Failed and ErrorText methods
implement_RpcChannel_subclass: implement a custom RpcChannel subclass that overrides CallMethod for remote service calls
handle_RpcException: handle RpcException errors raised by failed blocking RPC method calls in a try block
use_Service_CallMethod: call a service method using Service.CallMethod with a method descriptor and request message
